proposed_widenings.name: OngoingEffect.attack_roll
proposed_widenings.justification: Produce Flame's optional per-turn Magic action resolves as a ranged spell attack (d20 + spell attack mod vs AC) before dealing damage. OngoingEffect currently supports save_gate and EffectAtom but not attack_roll. The on_caster_spends_action trigger fires correctly; the missing piece is an attack_roll resolution variant in OngoingEffect that mirrors the existing save_gate variant. Without it the offensive half of the spell (its primary damage vector) cannot be encoded honestly.
proposed_widenings.evidence: Until the spell ends, you can take a Magic action to hurl fire at a creature or an object within 60 feet of you. Make a ranged spell attack. On a hit, the target takes 1d8 Fire damage.

notes: The passive half (emit_light + timed duration + caster_recasts_spell earlyEnd) encodes cleanly with existing atoms. The on_caster_spends_action trigger with kind=standard_action/action=magic also exists. Only the attack_roll variant in OngoingEffect is missing. Cantrip damage scaling (1d8 → 2d8 → 3d8 → 4d8 at levels 5/11/17) would use threshold_tiers with axis=character and scale_die_count. No dhall/json produced because omitting the attack roll would give a misleading trace.
